_read_me: Copy to demo_config.json. Replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value with a real id from the live database (states.id, districts.id, skills.id). The generator never invents ids. Signal types must match the vocabulary agreed in Issues #13/#17. Numbers below are demo shapes only and must never be used to choose official thresholds.
source_context: DEMO series for the SIH demo where source-backed district x skill history is shorter than 3 years. Ranges chosen for illustration only.
